_README: Human editorial controls. After editing, run `python tools/active_investors/refresh.py --build-only` to re-emit the public data. hidden_filing_ids: filing ids to hide from the public feed. pinned_filing_ids: float to the top of a card. hidden_investor_ids: drop an investor entirely. summary_overrides: replace the auto summary for a filing id, e.g. "edinet-S100XXXX": {"en":{"headline":"...","summary":"..."},"ja":{"headline":"...","summary":"..."}}. Find filing ids in compounders/active-investors/data/filings.json.
